_comment: Squatch gear on the walls, on the furniture, and printed on the things in the kitchen. Drop images into assets/art/ and point a slot at one. Slots without a file get a procedurally drawn placeholder. See README.md in this folder for the slot list.

art.title: The shield
art.caption: First thing you see every morning, whether you want to or not.

art.title: Swing or be swung
art.caption: Hung where you cannot avoid it. Some mornings it helps.

art.title: IEM Dallas 2022
art.caption: The first one. Nobody knew what they were doing and it did not matter.

art.title: The sweater
art.caption: Worth every penny. Worn exactly once.

art.title: GOOSKI

art.title: Under the lights

art.title: Focus
art.caption: Somebody who takes this more seriously than you do.

art.caption: Everybody matching. Nobody warmed up.

art.title: Kit on, all of us

art.title: The banner

art.title: The row

art.caption: Team shirt, someone else's aeroplane. Still counts.

art.title: Queueing at LOCALHOST

art.caption: Front row, cold pizza, everyone shouting at once.

art.title: Silver Sasquatches

art.caption: Full dress, nine medals, no record of service. East end of the dynasty wall.

art.title: The old man
art.caption: Smoking jacket, cigar, his own fireplace over his shoulder. Hung in the room with the fire in it.

art.title: The sit-down

art.title: The study, before
art.caption: The patriarch in his own study with a glass. Same chair. West pier of the office's north wall.

art.title: Survey of the grounds
art.caption: The Silver Sasquatch Domain, est. time immemorial, main house 1897. A man hangs a map of what he owns.

art.title: Rain, downtown
art.caption: Black and white, wet trench coat, one street lamp. The only one of the ten that is a movie.

art.title: The mark
art.caption: Silver on slate: the ridge line, the claw rake, the footprint. The one modern picture, in the one modern room.

art.title: The arena, behind the stage
art.caption: Hung on the swag behind the drum riser. The band plays under a full house.

art.title: The shirt

art.title: The Almighty

art.title: The bus
